name: analyze_contribution
description: Use this tool to analyze the contribution about changes to key metrics in multi-dimensional data.

contribution_metric.description:
The name of the column that contains the metric to analyze.
		Provides the expression to use to calculate the metric you are analyzing.
		To calculate a summable metric, the expression must be in the form SUM(metric_column_name),
		where metric_column_name is a numeric data type.
		To calculate a summable ratio metric, the expression must be in the form
		SUM(numerator_metric_column_name)/SUM(denominator_metric_column_name),
		where numerator_metric_column_name and denominator_metric_column_name are numeric data types.
		To calculate a summable by category metric, the expression must be in the form
		SUM(metric_sum_column_name)/COUNT(DISTINCT categorical_column_name). The summed column must be a numeric data type.
		The categorical column must have type BOOL, DATE, DATETIME, TIME, TIMESTAMP, STRING, or INT64.

dimension_id_cols.description: An array of column names that uniquely identify each dimension.

input_data.description: The data that contain the test and control data to analyze. Can be a fully qualified BigQuery table ID or a SQL query.

is_test_col.description: The name of the column that identifies whether a row is in the test or control group.

pruning_method.description: The method to use for pruning redundant insights. Can be 'NO_PRUNING' or 'PRUNE_REDUNDANT_INSIGHTS'.

top_k_insights_by_apriori_support.description: The number of top insights to return, ranked by apriori support.

name: ask_data_insights
description:
Use this tool to perform data analysis, get insights,
or answer complex questions about the contents of specific
BigQuery tables.

table_references.description: A JSON string of a list of BigQuery tables to use as context. Each object in the list must contain 'projectId', 'datasetId', and 'tableId'. Example: '[{"projectId": "my-gcp-project", "datasetId": "my_dataset", "tableId": "my_table"}]'.

user_query_with_context.description: The user's question, potentially including conversation history and system instructions for context.

name: execute_sql
description: Use this tool to execute sql statement.

dry_run.description: If set to true, the query will be validated and information about the execution will be returned without running the query. Defaults to false.

name: forecast
description: Use this tool to forecast time series data.

data_col.description: The name of the time series data column.

history_data.description: The table id or the query of the history time series data.

id_cols.description: An array of the time series id column names.

items.description: The name of time series id column.

timestamp_col.description: The name of the time series timestamp column.

name: get_dataset_info
description: Use this tool to get dataset metadata.

dataset.description: The dataset to get metadata information. Can be in `project.dataset` format.

project.description: The Google Cloud project ID containing the dataset.

name: get_table_info
description: Use this tool to get table metadata.

project.description: The Google Cloud project ID containing the dataset and table.

table.description: The table to get metadata information.

name: list_dataset_ids
description: Use this tool to list datasets.

project.description: The Google Cloud project to list dataset ids.

name: list_table_ids
description: Use this tool to list tables.

dataset.description: The dataset to list table ids.

project.description: The Google Cloud project ID containing the dataset.

name: search_catalog
description: Use this tool to find tables, views, models, routines or connections.

items.description: The IDs of the bigquery dataset.

pageSize.description: Number of results in the search page.

items.description: The IDs of the bigquery project.

prompt.description: Prompt representing search intention. Do not rewrite the prompt.

types.description: Array of data types to filter by.

items.description: The type of the data. Accepted values are: CONNECTION, POLICY, DATASET, MODEL, ROUTINE, TABLE, VIEW.
